deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration could not be imported
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description: Configuring {integration_title} via YAML is deprecated. While importing your YAML configuration, the Discogs API could not be reached. Restart Home Assistant to retry the import, or remove the `{domain}` sensor from your configuration and set up the integration from Settings > Devices & services.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration could not be imported
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description: Configuring {integration_title} via YAML is deprecated. While importing your YAML configuration, Discogs rejected the API token. Fix the token and restart Home Assistant to retry the import, or remove the `{domain}` sensor from your configuration and set up the integration from Settings > Devices & services.
